title: 4 Filters to Hear God Clearly
hook: Is it God, my anxiety, or just noise? Run it through these 4 filters.
script: Is it God, my anxiety, or just noise? Run it through these 4 filters. First, does it align with Scripture? God won’t contradict His Word; 2 Timothy 3:16 says all Scripture teaches and corrects. Second, does it lead to Christlike fruit—love, humility, repentance? Jesus said you’ll know a tree by its fruit in Matthew 7:16. Third, does wise, godly counsel confirm it? Proverbs 11:14 reminds us safety is found with many advisers. Fourth, do you sense peace with holy conviction, not panic? Colossians 3:15 says let Christ’s peace rule your heart. Quick prayer: Lord, speak. I’m listening. Guide me by Your Word, Your fruit, Your people, and Your peace. My Shepherd, I’m ready.

title: A 3-Minute Way to Test What You’re Hearing
hook: If God feels silent right now, try this simple test.
script: If God feels silent right now, try this simple test. Set a timer for three minutes. Breathe slow. Whisper: Jesus, I’m listening. Write the thought on your mind, then test it. Scripture: What verse supports or corrects this? Fruit: Would obeying make me more like Christ? Counsel: Which mature believer can I ask? Peace: Do I sense calm authority, not frantic pressure? If it fails a filter, release it. If it passes, take one small obedient step today. Pray: Speak, Lord; your servant is listening. My Shepherd knows me, and I follow His voice. Save this for the next swirl of thoughts—you’re not alone.

title: From Confusion to Clarity in 60 Seconds
hook: You may be overthinking this—God’s voice is clearer than you think.
script: You may be overthinking this—God’s voice is clearer than you think. Anxiety shouts now or else; the Spirit leads with peace and purpose. Here’s a fast reset: Pause and pray, Jesus, rule my thoughts. Read a few verses that speak to your situation; God won’t contradict His Word. Ask, Would this choice grow love, joy, and humility in me? Phone a wise, grounded friend for perspective. Finally, check your heart: calm, steady conviction or frantic fear? Choose the path marked by Scripture, Christlike fruit, wise counsel, and peace. John 10:27 reminds us His sheep hear His voice. Take the next faithful step.
